blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — As many as 18 former editors-in-chief (EICs) of UPLB Perspective, the official student publication of the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB), condemned the arrest and detention of student journalists during protests against the visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and the Pax Silica initiative. The police have detained 276 individuals who participated in the protest march at Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City on Sunday, November 15. Among those arrested and detained were former Perspective editor-in-chief Aira Domingo, who served from 2024-2025, and the campus […]...
